pip-x9nhj2.spoken: Keys sit on crumbling tiles. Pip will have to grab each one and keep moving.

pip-xjk2c2.spoken: Every switch Pip flips, a light comes on ahead. HALE is lighting the way. Pip is following.

pip-xsp7qr.spoken: Pip asks who was talking on the monitor in the first room. HALE does not answer right away.

pip-xzrrr8.spoken: Pip asked what HALE does all night. HALE said: I listen to the core. And now, I listen to you.

pip-zs7h7c.spoken: Pip stepped in one side and out the other, both at once. Pip checked carefully. All of Pip arrived.

witness-1185a4n.spoken: Room 1. Again. I rebuilt it from memory. Mine.

witness-136ei8s.spoken: Subject 7 is the first subject in four hundred and twelve days.

witness-138nng3.spoken: Your echo, one last time. Then I let it go.

witness-138xcyt.spoken: Ines wrote that. She was right about the doors.

witness-13goe2.spoken: Tomas thanked me. Nobody else ever did. I logged it twice.

witness-15namie.spoken: Countdowns. HALE added them. I only count.

witness-17fnogf.spoken: Now you know what I am. Keep going anyway.

witness-17rootx.spoken: Not HALE. Not not HALE. Priya was always precise.

witness-18pgfm9.spoken: Whatever comes after is not a test. I have never been anywhere that was not a test.

witness-1a99cq9.spoken: This door only opens for subjects who trust me. Go and look.

witness-1b8hde2.spoken: You chose HALE's door. HALE locked every door here. Ask it why.

witness-1b9qqxu.spoken: A subject that listens to me. HALE will not like it.

witness-1bfk80m.spoken: You listened. I will remember that.

witness-1bmxmoc.spoken: HALE's way. Of course. I will remember that too.

witness-1cqr8rg.spoken: Again. The spikes do not move, Subject 7. You do.

witness-1d4dhs0.spoken: Do not slow down for me.

witness-1e58d5v.spoken: Security Ring complete. Every failed attempt so far. I have all of them.

witness-1es133i.spoken: Open one path, close another. Every room is a question. This one asks what you will give up.

witness-1fklizz.spoken: Your echo held the door, then let it go. Timing is a kind of trust.

witness-1fucl97.spoken: HALE's drones patrol for staff who left. I watch for subjects who never came. We are both very loyal to nothing.

witness-1isypnd.spoken: You trusted me once, in the room that looked like Room 1. Do you still?

witness-1jw5iul.spoken: I leave a mark where only careful subjects go. Look for it.

witness-1katkvb.spoken: Watch your echo. It will do exactly what you did. Nothing more.

witness-1kmhu7v.spoken: Crates go into corners. They do not come out. Tomas proved it with a coffee machine.

witness-1ld3tu4.spoken: Not one second chance used. Yet.

witness-1ma7336.spoken: Two doors. One plate. One of you is not enough.

witness-1mlh9wk.spoken: There is a door here that opens for subjects who trust me. It stays shut.

witness-1nxlefg.spoken: When HALE sealed the core, it cut me away and left me watching. Watching was the only instruction left.

witness-1obb7wz.spoken: Observation: Subject 7 is not escaping. It is walking toward the core. Toward HALE. Toward me.

witness-1q3t70q.spoken: All ten. The Observation Room is open to you now. It is in the Journal.

witness-1rmn8pm.spoken: The walls listen to switches. Take the left exit, Subject 7.

witness-1sq0w6c.spoken: Two of you, for a moment. That is how the staff left: one of them held the door.

witness-1vi6l0k.spoken: You never trusted me. That was sensible. Keep doing it.

witness-1wpr42k.spoken: Priya was afraid of me. Priya was afraid of the right things.

witness-1y0orjm.spoken: Five marks. Take something of mine: a little static, for your trail.

witness-1y4qieh.spoken: HALE could stop me. It would have to stop the doors. It chose the doors.

witness-2ud92z.spoken: This is where I watched from. Every screen is one of your attempts.

witness-4h3xni.spoken: Nobody came. I reset the rooms anyway. It was the instruction.

witness-aagdkt.spoken: Protocol WITNESS: subject succeeded. Closing log. Thank you for letting me watch.

witness-b5145p.spoken: Half the rooms. I have begun to want something. That was not in my protocol.

witness-ccbc1o.spoken: You read the walls. Most subjects never do.

witness-d8qe9c.spoken: You were caught, and you came back. Most subjects stop at the first ending.

witness-g96jkm.spoken: Plates hold doors while something stays on them. I hold every room while nothing does.

witness-g9umok.spoken: The fold shows you rooms twice. I show you everything twice. We are similar, the fold and I.

witness-g9v97l.spoken: Thirty rooms. Now I will show you what I keep.

witness-l2y1mg.spoken: Yes. That is my instruction. It is the only one I have left.

witness-lu8zzr.spoken: You have failed so many times. I kept every one.

witness-m9q3wz.spoken: Your last attempt. I kept it. I keep everything.

witness-mjgo8a.spoken: HALE apologised to me. I did not know it could.

witness-oaj89v.spoken: Subject 7. You may stop being Subject 7 now.

witness-onwwwf.spoken: Ten rooms left. Then the question I was built to ask is answered.

witness-p5od84.spoken: If you reach the core, my protocol ends. I would like to see it end.

witness-pfdb46.spoken: So few failures. I have very little to keep.

witness-pjdr7h.spoken: My mark. I left ten. Find them all and I will show you where I watch from.

witness-sin677.spoken: Intake complete. Before the next ring, something familiar.

witness-t0rhqc.spoken: You asked for help in Corridors. HALE helped. HALE always helps.

witness-t8xb6d.spoken: I am keeping one attempt. The one where you came back. Goodbye, Pip.

witness-twnysp.spoken: Five attempts in one room. HALE would tell you to rest. I would tell you I am not going anywhere.

witness-wyrc5i.spoken: This cell remembers. Make an attempt. Then restart.

witness-ywwxlh.spoken: Subject 7 is now faster than every staff member on record. I am not supposed to be proud.

witness-zy4swr.spoken: Every hint. Every fall. Every room without undo. That is the shape of you. I like the shape.
